report_name: CISA Adds 10 More Exploited Flaws to KEV from Danfoss, HPE, Mitel, Vates

threat_actors.name: Malicious Actors
threat_actors.description: Unnamed malicious actors confirmed by CISA to be actively exploiting the ten vulnerabilities added to the KEV catalog on November 25, 2026.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: Malicious actors are actively exploiting vulnerabilities in internet-facing products from Danfoss, HPE, Mitel, and Vates. These exploits include path traversal, command injection, and improper authentication to gain initial access and potentially achieve remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2023-25914
vulnerabilities.description: A path traversal vulnerability in Danfoss AK-SM 800A series products is being actively exploited.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2023-25915
vulnerabilities.description: An improper input validation vulnerability in Danfoss AK-SM 800A series products is being actively exploited.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2025-41450
vulnerabilities.description: An improper authentication vulnerability in Danfoss AK-SM 800A series products is being actively exploited.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-103406
vulnerabilities.description: An OS command injection vulnerability in HPE Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router is being actively exploited.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-133275
vulnerabilities.description: An unrestricted file upload vulnerability in Mitel MiCollab is being actively exploited, which can lead to remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-133303
vulnerabilities.description: An XML injection vulnerability in Mitel MiCollab is being actively exploited.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-133311
vulnerabilities.description: A weak authentication vulnerability in Mitel MiCollab is being actively exploited.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-133323
vulnerabilities.description: An OS command injection vulnerability in Mitel MiCollab is being actively exploited, which can lead to remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-133324
vulnerabilities.description: A 'not failing securely' vulnerability in Mitel MiCollab is being actively exploited.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-133469
vulnerabilities.description: An improper validation of specified type of input vulnerability in Vates Xen Orchestra is being actively exploited.

identities.name: U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency
identities.description: CISA added ten vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, mandating federal agencies to patch them.

identities.name: Danfoss
identities.description: Vendor of the AK-SM 800A series system manager, which is affected by three of the newly listed exploited vulnerabilities.

identities.name: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE)
identities.description: Vendor of the Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router, which are affected by an exploited OS command injection vulnerability.

identities.name: Mitel
identities.description: Vendor of the MiCollab collaboration platform, which is affected by five of the newly listed exploited vulnerabilities.

identities.name: Vates
identities.description: Vendor of the Xen Orchestra web UI, which is affected by one of the newly listed exploited vulnerabilities.

indicators.name: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Path Traversal Attempt
indicators.pattern:
title: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Path Traversal Attempt (CVE-2023-25914)
id: 3b8a1c9d-e4f2-4b1a-8c7d-9e0f1a2b3c4d
status: experimental
description: Detects web requests with directory traversal patterns targeting Danfoss AK-SM 800A series devices, related to CVE-2023-25914.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2026/11/25/cisa-adds-10-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-25
tags:
  - attack.t1190
level: high
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    c-uri|contains:
      - '../'
      - '..%2f'
      - '..%c0%af'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: This rule detects web requests containing common path traversal patterns, which could indicate an attempt to exploit CVE-2023-25914 in Danfoss AK-SM 800A devices.

indicators.name: Mitel MiCollab Exploitation Attempts
indicators.pattern:
title: Mitel MiCollab Potential Exploitation Attempts (CVE-2026-133323, CVE-2026-133275)
id: 8f9e0d1c-2b3a-4d5e-6f7a-8b9c0d1e2f3a
status: experimental
description: Detects web request patterns associated with the exploitation of vulnerabilities in Mitel MiCollab, such as OS command injection (CVE-2026-133323) or unrestricted file upload (CVE-2026-133275).
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2026/11/25/cisa-adds-10-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-25
tags:
  - attack.t1190
level: high
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection_cmd:
    c-uri-query|contains:
      - 'cmd='
      - 'exec='
      - 'ping '
      - 'cat /etc/passwd'
  selection_upload:
    c-uri-stem|endswith:
      - '.jsp'
      - '.php'
      - '.aspx'
    cs-method: 'POST'
  condition: 1 of selection_*
indicators.description: This rule detects suspicious web requests that may indicate attempts to exploit OS command injection or unrestricted file upload vulnerabilities in Mitel MiCollab.
